metadata.name: RequestStock
metadata.description: This API is used to request plastic cards in Bulk for mentioned MSR.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Currency Code Ex. 840 = US Doller. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language ==  en: means use English ---- es: means Spanish Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: InstitutionID
request_fields.description: Unique identification number for Institution Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:Fixed value needs to pass which is provided by Corecard.

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: ID assigned to a Program Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:Fixed value provided by CoreCard.

request_fields.name: MerchantID
request_fields.description: Unique number of merchant account Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

request_fields.name: StoreID
request_fields.description: ID of the Store Valid Values: 0-9 Example:1234 Condition:Core Card will provide the value for this field after the Program is setup.

request_fields.name: HoldEmbossing
request_fields.description: Hold embossing indicator. Valid Values: 1= YES, 0 = NO Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: DeliveryMechanism
request_fields.description: Delivery Mechanism(Overnight, Priority or Standard). Valid Values: 0 -for Standard ,1 -for Priority , 2 -for Overnight Condition: Delivery mechanism is optional. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: NumberofCard
request_fields.description: Embossing quantity for request made. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:02

request_fields.name: Title
request_fields.description: Title of Person to whom stock is shipped. Format: A-Z Example:Mr Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: First name  of Person to whom stock is shipped. Valid Values:A-Z Example:User1 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MiddleName
request_fields.description: Middle Name of  Person to whom stock is shipped. Valid Values: A-Z Example: LEE Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Last name of  Person to whom stock is shipped. Valid Values:A-Z Example:Smith Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: NameOnCard
request_fields.description: Name to be printed on the card. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXX Example:John J Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: EmbossingLine4
request_fields.description: Embossing line4 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShippingAddressLine1
request_fields.description: Shipping address line 1 Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShippingAddressLine2
request_fields.description: Shipping address line 2. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:Park Avenue Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShippingCity
request_fields.description: Shipping address city name. Example:Los Angeles Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: ShippingState
request_fields.description: Sate of the shipping address. Example:Virginia Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: ShippingPostalCode
request_fields.description: Zip code of the shipping address. Valid Values:0-9 Example:46206 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: ShippingCountry
request_fields.description: Shipping address Country name Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: USA Allowable Values: 3
